verdict.rationale: uv is a traditional CLI tool with structured subcommands (uv init, uv add, uv run, uvx, etc.); no evidence shows any natural-language command interface, chat-based invocation, or NL-to-command translation built into the product itself. The llms.txt docs index (uv-docs-52) only helps external AI agents read documentation, it does not let a user type natural-language commands to uv.
